about.lead: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
bioParagraphs: My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention.

Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research.

My research experience and focus areas include: Clinical Surveillance & Antimicrobial Stewardship evaluating veterinary prescribing patterns, owner KAP, and self-medication behaviors in companion animals in Rajshahi; Nanomedicine & Computational Biology leading a registered systematic review and meta-analysis on nanoparticle-based Rabies vaccines; and Epidemiology & Parasitology examining ectoparasite dynamics in free-roaming dogs in the Barind Tract, Cimex spp. bedbug infestation risks in university halls, and molecular characterization of Capillaria spp. in native poultry.

Beyond academics, I am an active advocate for animal welfare. I regularly participate in hands-on snake rescue operations with Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN), Bangladesh, and dedicate time to providing free clinical services for stray and campus animals. I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in veterinary medicine, nanomedicine, and public health under the One Health framework.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Comparative Immunogenicity, Protective Efficacy, and Safety of Nanoparticle-Based Rabies Vaccines in Mice
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Synthesizing preclinical in vivo murine data following PRISMA guidelines using a Random-Effects Model to evaluate Virus-Neutralizing Antibody (VNA) kinetics, post-challenge survival rates, and platform-specific safety profiles across mRNA-LNPs, VLPs, lipopolyplexes, and nano-adjuvants.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: PoultryMedix: Autonomous Multimodal AI for Avian Health & AMR Stewardship
researchAndProjectsTimeline.institution: AI Battle (Send a little Hope UK)
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Multi-modal AI triage combining visual recognition of fecal lesions, acoustic respiratory distress analysis, optical character recognition (OCR) of handwritten prescriptions, and RAG-driven withdrawal alerts to enforce food safety and curb AMR for marginal poultry farmers.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Clinical Surveillance and Antimicrobial Stewardship in Companion Animals (Rajshahi)
researchAndProjectsTimeline.institution: Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: A 12-month prospective clinical surveillance investigating veterinary prescribing patterns, clinical syndrome frequencies, owner Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices (KAP), and hazardous home self-medication behaviors across private practices in Rajshahi.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: ZunSync (Evidentara): Reproducible AI Research Platform
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: An evidence-grounded computational research workbench engineered for veterinary epidemiologists, One Health scientists, and molecular researchers, featuring end-to-end data provenance tracking, literature synthesis pipelines, and Dockerized reproducibility.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Epidemiology and Distribution of Ectoparasites in Free-Roaming Dogs (Barind Tract)
researchAndProjectsTimeline.institution: Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Sampled 310 free-roaming dogs, collected 2,908 ectoparasites, established the first morphological records of Ctenocephalides orientis and Heterodoxus spiniger in Bangladesh, and conducted COX1/18S rRNA molecular sequencing of Haemaphysalis bispinosa and Dermacentor ticks.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Professor's Vet & Pet Care Clinic Web Application
researchAndProjectsTimeline.institution: Supervised by Dr. Abdulla Al Mamun Bhuyan
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Full clinic management web application and pet store featuring appointments, surgical case gallery, electronic prescriptions, and pharmacy inventory. Supervised by Dr. Abdulla Al Mamun Bhuyan (Associate Professor, Dept. of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, RU).

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Species Distribution and Risk Factors of Bedbug (Cimex spp.) Infestation in Student Residences
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Cross-sectional survey evaluating infestation rates, environmental sanitation risk factors, and sleep disturbances across a 370-bed cohort in high-density student residences.

researchAndProjectsTimeline.title: Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN) Bangladesh
researchAndProjectsTimeline.summary: Participating in emergency snake rescue, reptile rehabilitation, raptor release, and community biodiversity awareness drives across Rajshahi and Northern Bangladesh.

publications.title: Comparative Immunogenicity, Protective Efficacy, and Safety of Nanoparticle-Based Rabies Vaccines in Mice: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
publications.abstract: Registered systematic review and meta-analysis synthesizing in vivo preclinical murine data on next-generation nanoparticle rabies vaccines (mRNA-LNPs, VLPs, nano-adjuvants) following PRISMA guidelines using a random-effects model.

publications.title: Socio-Veterinary Determinants of Pet Animal Healthcare Behavior Among Pet Animal Owners in Bangladesh

trainings.title: Research Ethics Course
trainings.issuer: WHO Ethics Review Committee Secretariat, Global Health Ethics & Governance Unit
trainings.summary: Comprehensive certification in bioethics, biomedical human/animal research protocol governance, informed consent, and international review standards.
trainings.fullDetails: Comprehensive course covering the core ethical principles of biomedical research, protocols for vulnerable populations, risk-benefit evaluations, conflict-of-interest disclosures, and the governance frameworks mandated by the World Health Organization (WHO) Ethics Review Committee.

trainings.title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programmes in Health-Care Facilities
trainings.summary: Specialized training on implementing AMS toolkits in low- and middle-income country settings to combat drug resistance.
trainings.fullDetails: Covers diagnostic stewardship, surveillance of antimicrobial consumption (AWaRe classification), prescription auditing, behavioral change interventions, and institutional stewardship frameworks designed specifically for resource-constrained LMIC settings.

trainings.title: One Health: Basics of Multisectoral Collaboration
trainings.summary: Multisectoral collaboration mechanisms at the human-animal-environment interface for zoonotic pathogen prevention.
trainings.fullDetails: In-depth study of operationalizing the One Health Joint Plan of Action (OH JPA), joint risk assessment (JRA) tools, cross-sectoral epidemiological information sharing, and integrated surveillance across veterinary and human health ministries.

trainings.title: Healthcare Associated Infection (HAI) Surveillance
trainings.issuer: Infection Prevention and Control Unit & Hub (IPC Unit), WHO
trainings.summary: Methodologies for active and passive nosocomial infection surveillance, data validation, and IPC indicator monitoring.
trainings.fullDetails: Detailed instruction in active case finding, surgical site infection (SSI) tracking, catheter-associated urinary tract infection (CAUTI) surveillance, environmental sanitation audits, and epidemiological feedback loops.

trainings.title: AMMnet Insights: Malaria Modeling Workshop
trainings.summary: Mathematical and spatial modeling of vector transmission dynamics for public health professionals in Bangladesh.
trainings.fullDetails: Hands-on trainee workshop on compartmental infectious disease models (SIR/SEIR), calculating entomological inoculation rates (EIR), incorporating rainfall and temperature covariates, and forecasting transmission hot-spots.

trainings.title: WOAH Sensitization Workshop on AMR
trainings.issuer: WOAH & Rajshahi Medical College Hospital / University of Rajshahi
trainings.summary: Global standards for veterinary antimicrobial use, prudent prescribing, and national action plan (NAP) alignment.
trainings.fullDetails: Trainee workshop reviewing WOAH Terrestrial Animal Health Code standards, veterinary critically important antimicrobials (VCIAs), farm-level biosecurity, and inter-agency collaboration between DLS and DGHS in Bangladesh.

trainings.title: 21-Day Python Programming Masterclass
trainings.summary: Daily intensive coding bootcamp covering OOP, data structures, automation, web scraping, and biological data processing.
trainings.fullDetails: Comprehensive curriculum covering abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, regex, pandas data cleaning, matplotlib visualization, and algorithm implementation for life-science data.

trainings.title: Climate Change International Legal Regime
trainings.summary: International environmental law, multilateral biodiversity treaties, and climate adaptation frameworks.
trainings.fullDetails: Examination of UNFCCC, Paris Agreement mechanisms, biodiversity conventions, and their direct linkages to emerging infectious diseases, habitat fragmentation, and global environmental health.

trainings.title: 2nd Bangladesh Veterinary Olympiad 2023
trainings.summary: Nationwide competitive veterinary examination testing clinical diagnosis, infectious diseases, and animal production.
trainings.fullDetails: Rigorous multi-round competitive Olympiad testing veterinary pharmacology, pathology, surgery, epidemiology, and livestock economics among top DVM students across Bangladesh.
